text: [tense] Your AI agent just read this.
It holds fifty NEAR. It has the keys. One bad prompt is enough.
[confident] Dry Run catches the request... and plays it first, in a copy of the chain.
In the copy, forty-nine NEAR would leave the vault. That breaks the two NEAR cap. [firm] Blocked, before any signature.
On NEAR, the agent's key can only call the vault, and the vault enforces its cap on-chain. On testnet: five NEAR... refused.
[warmly] Dry Run. Every transaction happens twice. What would you let your agent spend without asking?
